doc: A plan system's output (design/planner.md, What a plan holds): the village's shape as cells, its plots (buildings, road segments, waterfronts, water), its entrances, a navigation mesh over its roads, the nature ground a plotter grows in its open land, and the report that proves every plot is reached.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The village's cells: its plots, roads, water, walls, gates, and the open land it keeps.

fields.name: plots
fields.doc: The plots open at the tier.

fields.name: entrances
fields.doc: The entrance (gate) cells, as q, r pairs.

fields.name: lines
fields.doc: Where walls, the keep's wall, and fences would go, as lines of points with their gates.

fields.name: nature
fields.doc: The ground for a plotter: the village's cells and an apron round it, open land available (with its heights and moisture), water as water, and everything built unavailable, so nature fills the gaps.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: The working site's radius, cells (the village's shape lies within it).

fields.name: nav_vertices
fields.doc: The navigation mesh's vertices, metres.

fields.name: nav_polys
fields.doc: Its polygons' vertex indices, nav_counts[i] each in order: a road cell's hex (six), or the half its edge piece leaves (five).

fields.name: nav_counts
fields.doc: How many vertices each polygon has.

fields.name: nav_flags
fields.doc: Each polygon's flags: 1 walk, 2 cart.

fields.name: nav_area
fields.doc: Each polygon's area: 0 street, 1 square, 3 bridge, 4 gate.

fields.name: nav_links
fields.doc: Neighbouring polygons a walker crosses between, as pairs: only across edges both cells' flows use.

fields.name: plots_unreached
fields.doc: Plots some open entrance doesn't reach (must be 0).

fields.name: cart_unreached
fields.doc: Stores, workshops, inns, waterfronts, and civic plots no cart reaches (must be 0).

fields.name: repairs
fields.doc: Plots given up for open land because they couldn't be reached.

fields.name: longest_walk_m
fields.doc: The longest walk from an entrance to a plot, metres.

fields.name: steepest_street
fields.doc: The steepest step along a road, rise over run.

fields.name: highest_step_m
fields.doc: The highest step a walker climbs on the mesh, metres.

fields.name: retaining_m
fields.doc: Metres of edge where levelling left neighbours more than 0.3 m apart beside something built.

fields.name: open_cells
fields.doc: Open cells the village keeps (its gardens, greens, and backs: the plotter's).

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Why the plan fell short, if it did.
